title: fix(docs): clear the check-links sweep's 10 rejections at their source
body:
Part of #8128.

⚠️ **Deliberately `Part of`, not a closing keyword.** The card is closed by a *named run* showing the sweep green, and this session could not produce one: `POST /actions/workflows/check-links.yml/dispatches` answers `403 Resource not accessible by integration` (`X-Accepted-GitHub-Permissions: actions=write`; this token has `actions=read`). The next scheduled sweep, or a maintainer's `workflow_dispatch`, is the thing that closes it. Leaving the card open is the honest half.

## The measurement, which came before any edit

⛔ Triage fixed the order — get the number first, because 2 broken links and 200 broken links are different cards. **The number is 10**, and it is stable:

| run | trigger | date | Lychee errors |
|---|---|---|---|
| [31295178818](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/31295178818) | `schedule` | 2026-08-09T04:43Z | **9** |
| [34011606950](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/34011606950) | `schedule` | 2026-09-06T04:28Z | **10** |

Same URLs in both, a month apart; the extra one is a link written into `data-objectstack.mdx` in between. ⇒ **A stable verdict, not network weather.** Timeouts: 0. Anchor failures: 0. Full per-URL list with file and line is [on the card](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/issues/8128#issuecomment-5572673262).

The reading comes from the CI runs' own logs rather than from a fresh dispatch — which is the *stronger* source: it is what the workflow actually decided, not a reproduction of it.

## The three classes, each measured

### A. Genuinely broken — 3 rejections, fixed at the source

- **`github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/discussions`** (404) — `GET /repos/objectstack-ai/objectui` reports `has_discussions: false`. Discussions is **not enabled** on this repo, so the link points at a page that does not exist. The bullet is removed; the `GitHub Issues` bullet beside it is live and stays.
  - ⚠️ Worth a maintainer's glance: the alternative fix is *enabling* Discussions. That is a repo setting and a product decision, not a docs edit, so it is not made here.
- **`objectstack.dev/docs`** ×2 (connection failure) — `objectstack.dev` is **NXDOMAIN**; `objectstack.ai` resolves. Repointed at **`docs.objectstack.ai`**, chosen because it is the one candidate that is *both* already used in this repo (`content/docs/guide/objectos-integration.mdx`) *and* proven green by run 34011606950 itself (307, and 307 is in `lychee.toml`'s `accept` list). ⛔ `objectstack.ai/docs` reads more naturally and was **not** used: sibling paths under it are green, but the bare `/docs` path is unverified from here (egress policy blocks the host), and a plausible URL is not an established one.

### B. Hostile host — 7 rejections, exempted with the reason stated

All seven are `www.npmjs.com/package/@object-ui/*`, all `403`. ⭐ **The packages are live.** Direct `registry.npmjs.org`, 2026-09-07:

```
@object-ui/plugin-ai  plugin-designer  plugin-list  plugin-report
create-plugin  data-objectstack  runner        ->  200, dist-tags.latest = 17.6.0
```

npm answers **404, not 403**, for a package that is not there ⇒ the 403 is anti-scraping aimed at the runner, and carries no verdict about the target.

**Scoped to `^https://www.npmjs.com/package/`, not to `@object-ui/*`** — the host's answer does not depend on which package is named, so a third-party npm link would be rejected identically, and a per-URL list would grow a line every time a doc page names a package. ⛔ This is **not** the blanket wildcard the card warns about: a uniform 403 carries zero information, so no true detection is being suppressed — only the noise that made 7 of the 10 rejections unreadable.

⚠️ The honest other half: the whole swept corpus holds exactly these 7 npm links and all 7 are red, so there is **no green npm link inside the corpus** acting as a control. The control is the registry read, which is outside it.

### C. Timeouts / anchors — 0.

## What is NOT in this PR

⛔ **The reporting mechanism.** Triage deferred that explicitly and it stays deferred — nothing here proposes, prototypes, or prejudges it. ⛔ `.github/workflows/**` is untouched; the two disabled triggers stay disabled (#3213 ruling B).

## Verification

⚠️ **A local Lychee run is evidence about the links, not about the CI job**, and in this container it is not even fully that: the session's egress proxy `connect_rejected`s `tailwindcss.com`, `reactjs.org`, `developer.mozilla.org`, `img.shields.io` and others, and `github.com` / `npmjs.com` 403s come from the session's own GitHub gateway (body: `{"message":"GitHub access to this repository is not enabled for this session..."}`), not from GitHub. So the local run's 55 → 47 error count is **not** a link-health reading and is not offered as one.

What the local run *does* establish, proxy-independently, is the **delta**. lychee 0.24.2, the workflow's argument list verbatim, before vs after:

```
unique rejected URLs removed:  9   (1 discussions + 1 objectstack.dev + 7 npm)
unique rejected URLs added:    0
excluded:  368 -> 375  (+7, the npm package pages)
```

⇒ Every one of the sweep's 10 rejections is gone from the corpus, and **nothing new is rejected**. The exclusion was also checked for over-reach: `www.npmjs.com/package/react` excluded, `www.npmjs.com/settings/...` still checked, `registry.npmjs.org` still checked.

### Gates (exit codes captured before any pipe)

| gate | verdict |
|---|---|
| `node scripts/check-doc-links.mjs` | ✅ 0 — `Links are valid across 17 scan roots.` |
| `pnpm check:doc-snippets` | ✅ 0 — `632 of 632 block(s) judged, 0 failed` (after the scoped 35-package build it requires; its first run exited **2**, which is "could not run", not a failure) |
| `pnpm check:doc-fences` | ✅ 0 — 227 documents |
| `pnpm lint:root` | ✅ 0 — 0 errors (32 pre-existing warnings, none in the changed files) |
| `pnpm check:control-bytes` | ✅ 0 — 6648 tracked text files |
| `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` | ✅ 0 — `no changeset is owed` (3 files changed, 0 published source) |
| `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` | ✅ 0 — **NOT GOVERNED**, all 3 paths |
| `vitest scripts/__tests__/check-links-workflow.test.ts check-doc-links.test.ts` | ✅ 0 — 130 passed (the two suites that read `lychee.toml`) |

## Filed separately, out of scope for this PR

- **#8381** — the same stale `objectstack.dev` domain survives in two *code-fence* `baseUrl` examples in the same file. Lychee cannot see inside fences, so the sweep never named them; and the right replacement for an **API** host is not establishable from here, unlike a docs link. Left for someone who knows.
- **#8382** — nothing verifies those seven packages are still published. The sweep's 403s never carried that signal; this PR stops it appearing to. ⛔ No gate is proposed — it is a coverage reading for triage, and `lychee.toml`'s comment names the card so the gap is not implied.
